$comment: The differences between a document and its Spanish translation that are legitimate, each with its reason (e2e/docs/translations.mjs, make docs-check). kind is one of code-block, inline-code, link, figure, structure, english or term, with the value the check reports; link-map gives the link a translation takes instead of the one of its original, in every section or only under the original's heading named in under. make docs-check fails on an exception that no longer matches anything.

exceptions.reason: Each index names its counterpart in the other language: the English index points to the Spanish one, and the Spanish index to the English one.
The English index lists the Spanish README as the README in the other language; the Spanish index lists the English README in that place.
Keep a Changelog publishes the same version of its format in Spanish, and the Spanish changelog links that page.
Semantic Versioning publishes the same version of its specification in Spanish, and the Spanish changelog links that page.
